ingredientSections.heading: Marinated Portobello & Onion
items: ½ Cup agave syrup or coconut nector

ingredientSections.heading: Salsa
items: Pinch sea salt and pepper to taste

methodSections.heading: Marinated Portobello And Onion
steps: Dice the onion and clean and remove the stalk from the mushrooms. Mix the nama shoyu or tamari with the syrup or nector and 1 cup of water in a large baking dish. Add the onions and allow to marinate for 1-3 hours.

Add the mushrooms and allow to marinate for another hour. Drain and place in a dehydrator for 10 hours at 45°C (115°F). Or place in a baking dish, marinade liquid and all, into the oven preheated to 180°C (350°F) for 20 minutes or until the mushrooms are soft. Remove the mushrooms and onions from the liquid.

methodSections.heading: Veg Burger
steps: Add all ingredients to a food processor and process until everything comes together. Form the processed mix into 6 burger patties.

Transfer to a dehydrated tray and dry them for 6 hours before flipping and drying the other side for other 4 hours. Start at the dehydrator’s highest temperature for 1 hour and then reduce the temperature 45°C (115°F).

If you don’t have a dehydrator and don’t follow a raw diet, you can bake the burgers in the oven on parchment paper at 180°C (350°F) for 20 minutes on one side before flipping and cooking for another 5 minutes.

methodSections.heading: Alfredo Sauce
steps: Soak the cashews in water for 2 hours, drain and rince under fresh water.
Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until creamy.

methodSections.heading: Guacamole
steps: Remove the skin and seed from the avocados, add all ingredients to a food processor and process until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Salsa
steps: Chop the cilantro and jalapeño, peel and dice the mango and dice the tomato.
Mix everything together in a bowl with a fork and adjust the seasoning and acidity if necessary.

methodSections.heading: To Serve
steps: Arrange the mushrooms with gills facing up on a work surface. Generously spread the alfredo sauce on the mushrooms and top this with some marinated onions.
Add the patty next and spread it liberally with guacamole. Sprinkle salsa on top of the guacamole.
Serve with your choice of fresh salad, cut tomatoes and dehydrated eggplant and dress with the Alfredo Sauce.
